ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile web app that uses edge AI models to detect regional crop diseases from smartphone camera feeds and predicts local yields.
ideas.title: AgriYield AI: Localized Crop Disease and Yield Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Open Innovation track with high regional relevance for Indian agriculture, making it instantly relatable to local judges.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized platform for issuing and instantly verifying tamper-proof graduation certificates and transcripts on-chain.
ideas.title: VeriCert: Blockchain Academic Credential Verification
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the Blockchain track by solving a real institutional bottleneck for colleges and employers.

ideas.pitch: A Web3 decentralized storage marketplace for students to buy, sell, and share academic notes and project files using micro-tokens.
ideas.title: CampusMesh: Decentralized Peer-to-Peer Study Material Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages Web3 technology for a relatable campus-focused use case, appealing directly to a student-led hackathon jury.

ideas.pitch: An AI pipeline that takes audio recordings or transcripts of college lectures and automatically generates structured summary notes and interactive concept mind maps.
ideas.title: AI Lecture Summarizer and Concept Map Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate pain point for engineering students preparing for exams, ensuring high engagement during demonstrations.

ideas.pitch: A browser extension and web tool that analyzes uploaded images and short video clips to flag AI-generated deepfakes with a confidence breakdown.
ideas.title: TrustVerify AI: Multimedia Deepfake Detection Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a timely cybersecurity and trust problem in the AI track with clear, visual proof-of-concept outputs for judges.
